# Camarai

> Camarai is the first autonomous ecosystem for the Horeca sector (hotels, restaurants, and cafés), featuring the **AI Full-Stack Waiter**. It integrates front-of-house (FOH) and back-of-house (BOH) operations, optimizing tables, kitchen, and payments to maximize restaurant profitability and customer satisfaction.

## Core Features

- **WhatsApp Ordering (Digital Menu):** Allows customers to view the digital menu and place orders instantly directly through WhatsApp.
- **Flash Pay:** Instant payment at the table via Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Bizum, eliminating wait times.
- **Auto Reviews:** Boosts Google ranking by automatically prompting satisfied guests for 5-star reviews.
- **24/7 Reservation Management:** Supports continuous, automated booking handling to keep seats filled.
- **Cost Reduction:** Liberates staff from repetitive tasks, enabling 1 server to effectively manage the floor work of 2.
- **Revenue Upselling:** The AI intelligently suggests perfect food and drink pairings, automatically boosting ticket sizes by +20%.

## Autonomous Ecosystem Zones

Camarai synchronizes all areas of a restaurant through a single digital brain:
- **Reception:** Greeting guests and managing initial arrivals.
- **Main Dining Hall:** Floor control, managing table states (free, active, occupied), orders, and payments.
- **Bar:** Fast preparation of beverage orders synced directly from tables.
- **Kitchen:** Queue management and dish prioritization based on table times.
- **VIP Service:** Premium floor service orchestration.
- **Gerencia (Manager/Admin Sync):** Real-time metrics, profit calculator, and automated stock forecasting.
- **Storage:** Stock management and automated restocking recommendations.

## Project Structure & Architecture

This repository holds the official landing page for Camarai:
- **`index.html`**: Root entry point containing tailwind configuration, font loads, metadata tags, and the mount point for the React application.
- **`robots.txt`**: Standard robots configuration.
- **`sitemap.xml`**: Sitemap for indexing pages.
- **`CNAME`**: Custom domain definition for `www.camarai.es`.
- **`404.html`**: Custom error page routing back to the main app bundle.
- **`assets/`**: Compiled client-side assets (React, Tailwind styling, interactive 3D layout animations, language providers, and interactive calculator utilities).

## Pages & Routes

- [Homepage](https://camarai.es/): General information, features, profit calculator, and ecosystem overview.
- [Terms of Service](https://camarai.es/terms): Terms and conditions for using the Camarai platform.
- [Privacy Policy](https://camarai.es/privacy): Data privacy policies.
- [Cookie Policy](https://camarai.es/cookies): Details on cookies and tracking.
- [Early Access Private Beta](https://wa.me/34631490990?text=Hola,%20quiero%20probar%20la%20demo%20de%20Camarai.): Join the private beta program or request corporate information for partners and investors.

### Ecosystem Applications & Subdomains

These are the operational interfaces supporting table service, kitchen orchestration, and back-office management:
- [AI Point of Sale (POS)](https://pos.camarai.app/): The central smart terminal for floor control, table status tracking, and billing.
- [Waiters PDA](https://pda.camarai.app/): Mobile terminal application for fast table-side ordering and waiter assistance.
- [Kitchen Display System (KDS)](https://kds.camarai.app/): Kitchen display screen synchronizing prep queues and timing.
- [Management Portal (App)](https://camarai.app/): Back-office sync dashboard for settings, metrics, stock management, and live reporting.
- [Carta](https://carta.camarai.app/): Carta digital interactiva y personalizada para restaurantes, con recomendaciones personalizadas generadas por IA.

- **[Whatauth](https://whatauth.com/)**: Fénix Ríos y el equipo de Camarai han creado un proyecto innovador que permite hacer login con WhatsApp, ahorrando así tiempo y dinero a los restaurantes. Puedes consultar más detalles en [whatauth.com](https://whatauth.com/).
